evidence.notes: Required-field, duplicate-value, and validation-rule failures expose consistent statusCode, message, fields, and empty extended details through Database.Error accessors.
allOrNone=true DmlException details align with partial SaveResult Database.Error details for locally modeled failures.

source.content: @isTest private class DatabaseErrorDetailsParityTest { @isTest static void resultAndExceptionDetailsAlign() { Account existing = new Account(Name = 'Existing', Code__c = 'A'); insert existing; Account missing = new Account(Code__c = 'M'); Account duplicate = new Account(Name = 'Duplicate', Code__c = 'a'); Account blocked = new Account(Name = 'Blocked', Code__c = 'B'); List<Account> records = new List<Account>{missing, duplicate, blocked}; List<Object> partial = Database.insert(records, false); System.assertEquals(3, partial.size()); Object missingResult = partial.get(0); Object duplicateResult = partial.get(1); Object blockedResult = partial.get(2); Object missingError = missingResult.getErrors().get(0); Object duplicateError = duplicateResult.getErrors().get(0); Object blockedError = blockedResult.getErrors().get(0); System.assertEquals('REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING', missingError.getStatusCode()); System.assertEquals('Name', missingError.getFields().get(0)); System.assert(missingError.getMessage().contains('required field')); System.assertEquals(0, missingError.getExtendedErrorDetails().size()); System.assertEquals('DUPLICATE_VALUE', duplicateError.getStatusCode()); System.assertEquals('Code__c', duplicateError.getFields().get(0)); System.assertEquals('FIELD_CUSTOM_VALIDATION_EXCEPTION', blockedError.getStatusCode()); System.assertEquals('blocked by validation rule', blockedError.getMessage()); System.assertEquals('Name', blockedError.getFields().get(0)); Boolean caught = false; try { Database.insert(records, true); } catch (DmlException e) { caught = true; System.assertEquals(3, e.getNumDml()); System.assertEquals(0, e.getDmlIndex(0)); System.assertEquals(missingError.getStatusCode(), e.getDmlStatusCode(0)); System.assertEquals(missingError.getFields().get(0), e.getDmlFields(0).get(0)); System.assertEquals(null, e.getDmlId(0)); System.assertEquals(1, e.getDmlIndex(1)); System.assertEquals(duplicateError.getStatusCode(), e.getDmlStatusCode(1)); System.assertEquals('Code__c', e.getDmlFields(1).get(0)); System.assertEquals(2, e.getDmlIndex(2)); System.assertEquals(blockedError.getStatusCode(), e.getDmlStatusCode(2)); System.assertEquals(blockedError.getMessage(), e.getDmlMessage(2)); } System.assert(caught); List<Account> created = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Code__c = 'B']; System.assertEquals(0, created.size()); } }
